facetedcategory-combination-invalid: A category combination needs a name and at least two categories.
apihelp-query+facetedcategories-summary: Search the faceted categories by their members.
apihelp-query+facetedcategories-param-se: Text to find in the member of a faceted category. With a slash, the text before it is the facet and the text after it starts the member. Without a text, the categories with the most pages are listed.
apihelp-query+facetedcategories-param-fa: Only search the members of this facet.
apihelp-query+facetedcategories-example-: Find faceted categories whose member contains <kbd>politic</kbd>.
Find the members of the facet <kbd>Job</kbd> starting with <kbd>P</kbd>.
apihelp-query+categoryfacets-summary: List the facets in which pages are categorized the most.
apihelp-query+categoryfacets-example-lim: List the 20 facets in which pages are categorized the most.
facetedcategory-intro: Browse the faceted categories, the categories named like "Facet/Member", and find the pages in several categories at once.
facetedcategory-show-intersection: Show the pages in all the chosen categories
facetedcategory-needs-category: Choose a category the pages are in, not only categories they are not in.
facetedcategory-named-combination: A category combination named by editors
facetedcategory-no-results: No page is in all these categories.
facetedcategory-exclude: Show the pages not in $1 instead
